description: Redesign the landing page (pre-meeting state) to be visually appealing with clear CTAs for creating a new meeting or joining an existing one. Currently, the pre-meeting state just shows a Card with 'You're not in a meeting yet!' and a ControlBar at the bottom with an input and join button. Replace this with a proper centered landing page that has a hero section, clear instructions, and prominent actions.
steps: Create a new component src/components/LandingPage.tsx that serves as the pre-meeting landing page. It should include: (1) A centered hero section with the app name/tagline and a brief description of what the app does (zero-auth video conferencing). (2) Two clear action sections: 'Start a New Meeting' button that generates a random meeting ID and joins immediately, and a 'Join an Existing Meeting' section with a text input for the meeting PIN and a join button. (3) Use @aws-amplify/ui-react components (Heading, Text, Button, Card, Flex, View, TextField, Divider, useTheme) for consistent styling. (4) Include visual polish: good spacing using Amplify UI tokens, a card-based layout with elevation, appropriate heading hierarchy, and responsive design. (5) Add a brief feature list or instruction hints (e.g., 'No sign-up required', 'Share your meeting PIN to invite others', 'Supports screen sharing and recording').

Refactor src/components/MeetingControlBar.tsx: Extract the meeting join logic (handleJoin, isValidMeetingName, the useEffect for URL-based join) so it can be reused. The MeetingControlBar should only show meeting controls (leave, share, record, audio/video) when in a meeting - remove the pre-meeting input/join UI from it since that moves to LandingPage.

Update src/App.tsx to render <LandingPage /> when joinedMeetingId is empty instead of the current Card. Pass the necessary callbacks (a join handler and a create handler) to LandingPage. Keep the URL-based auto-join logic (from useEffect in MeetingControlBar) working - it should still auto-join when a path like /meeting-pin is visited.

Add a CSS file src/components/LandingPage.css for any styles that cannot be achieved with inline Amplify UI tokens (e.g., subtle gradient backgrounds, hover transitions, max-width containers). Keep it minimal and focused.
Ensure the Header component still renders above the landing page and that the overall page looks cohesive.
acceptance_criteria: When no meeting is joined, a visually appealing landing page is shown with clear 'Start a Meeting' and 'Join a Meeting' sections
The 'Start a Meeting' button creates a random meeting PIN and initiates joining
The 'Join a Meeting' section has a text field for entering a PIN and a join button
Invalid meeting PIN shows an appropriate error or alert
Visiting a URL like /some-meeting-pin still auto-joins that meeting
Once in a meeting, the video grid, control bar, attendee list, and copy link all still work as before
The page is responsive and looks good on both desktop and mobile viewports
